source_summary: Horizontal Chinese landscape handscroll with misty lake, distant blue-green mountains, small boats, flying birds, and a dense right-side rocky shore with expressive trees. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper tone are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: left_wooded_peak_ridges
motifs.description: Isolate the left cluster of rounded blue-green mountains: the high wooded peak, sloping ridgelines, lower haze-softened hills, and dotted vegetation along crests. Exclude overlying inscriptions and seals.
must_preserve: dark dotted tree texture on crests
misty lower edges fading into the lake

motifs.name: central_distant_blue_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the low, receding chain of distant blue peaks across the upper middle distance, including the pale washes and subtly overlapping silhouettes. Exclude calligraphy above.

motifs.name: left_shore_sampans_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the small left shoreline scene with clustered dark sampans, low reed banks, sparse trees, and the narrow strip of water beside them. Do not include nearby seals or upper mountains.
must_preserve: small tree trunks and foliage dots

motifs.name: misty_lake_with_flying_birds
motifs.description: Isolate the open misty lake surface with scattered flying birds and faint horizontal water bands. Keep it as an atmospheric water-and-sky passage without including boats or shore clusters.
must_preserve: small white and dark bird marks

motifs.name: central_canopy_boat_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the central curved boat with two scholar figures, arched canopy, bundled cargo, oars, and upturned prow and stern. Exclude surrounding empty lake except the immediate boat wash shadow.
must_preserve: warm tan and blue-green color accents

motifs.name: midright_gnarled_vine_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right gnarled, low spreading tree with bare twisting branches, hanging reddish vines or leaves, and small adjacent foliage clumps. Avoid merging it with the taller tree grove to the right.

motifs.name: right_tall_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall grove on the right: large dark-leaved tree, pale trunks, interlaced bare branches, and surrounding smaller trees rising from the slope. Exclude seals and unrelated right-edge inscriptions.
must_preserve: reddish leaf accents on smaller trees
layered green hillside wash behind trunks

motifs.name: right_foreground_rocky_bank_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the rocky foreground bank along the lower right, including angular boulders, dark shrub masses, grasses, and the sloped shoreline base beneath the trees. Avoid including the upper tree crowns.
must_preserve: broken contour lines on the bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
